'''2014 Texas Mini Worlds Day 1 Amar Banger LS It Is The Future You See (V)''' was the Light Side constructed list played by [[Amar Banger]] at [[2014 Texas Mini Worlds]] (Day 1).


== Deck info ==

* '''Starting Card:''' {{CardLink|It Is The Future You See (V) (Virtual Block 2)|VB2-L-itisthefutureyousee-pre.gif|label=It Is The Future You See / A Tremor In The Force (V)}}
* '''Username:''' abanger
* '''Format:''' [[Legacy Open]]
* '''Stage:''' Day 1
